tax.text: Gill said he supports lowering taxes across the board and making the Trump tax cuts permanent.
tax.quote: I support lowering taxes across the board for all Americans and making the Trump tax cuts permanent.

trade.text: Gill said he supports keeping President Trump's tariffs in place.
trade.quote: But right now, the President put these tariffs in place, and I think that they should stay there.

schools.text: Gill said he supports school choice, including vouchers, tax credits, charter schools, private schools, and homeschooling.
schools.quote: I support school choice, including voucher programs, tax credits, charter schools, private schools, and home schools.

safety.text: Gill said he backs police and opposes redirecting funds from police departments to community programs.
safety.quote: When you're being robbed, you don't call a social worker or community organizer. I fully back the blue and would not support any efforts to defund the police.

immigration.text: Gill supported a border wall, changes to asylum laws, and restoring the Remain in Mexico policy.
immigration.quote: Securing the southern border is one of the most important jobs the federal government has right now. We need to build a physical wall across the entire border, reform our asylum laws, and restore Remain in Mexico.

guns.text: Gill said he opposes restrictions on gun ownership and would defend gun owners’ Second Amendment rights.
guns.quote: I do not support any restrictions on gun ownership. Despite what liberals may say, gun ownership keeps Americans safe. I will do whatever I can to protect Americans losing any of their Second Amendment rights.

abortion.text: Gill described himself as pro-life and said the federal government should act to save unborn children.
abortion.quote: The Federal government should do everything it can to save as many babies from being murdered as possible.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Gill said biological males should not participate in women’s sports or occupy women’s spaces.
gender.quote: Biological males should not be allowed to participate in women's sports or occupy biological women's spaces whether it be bathrooms, locker rooms, sorority houses, women's shelters, or prison.

health.text: Gill said Medicare and Medicaid should remain available while health care moves toward a free-market approach.
health.quote: Medicaid and Medicare have long-term funding issues, but millions of elderly and disabled Americans depend on them and we cannot pull the rug from underneath them at this point. But it is important that we move towards a more free market approach to healthcare that will end up reducing prices and providing better services.

energy.text: Gill opposed urgent political action on climate change and called for increased domestic drilling and fracking.
energy.quote: Drill baby drill. America must increase domestic energy production by using the resources we have at home. This includes reinstating the Keystone XL pipeline, increasing drilling, fracking, and replenishing our SPRs that Joe Biden depleted.

voting.text: Gill said every state should require voter ID to cast a ballot.
voting.quote: We should not live in a country where you need a voter ID to buy an alcoholic beverage, cigarettes, and lottery cards but not to vote. The left is constantly crying that our democracy is under threat by Donald Trump but do not ensure our ballots are secure. This is a no-brainer: every state should mandate voter ID to cast a ballot.

wages.text: He supports protections for workers who discuss pay or organize.
wages.quote: Protect workers from retaliation for discussing pay or organizing.

trade.text: He supports tariffs in limited cases to protect domestic industries but opposes broad tariffs that raise consumer and business costs.
trade.quote: Tariffs can be a useful tool in limited circumstances, but blanket tariffs often raise costs for American consumers and small businesses.

debt.text: He opposes cuts or privatization of Social Security and Medicare and opposes raising the retirement age.
debt.quote: Protect Social Security and Medicare from cuts or privatization. Oppose raising the retirement age.

schools.text: He supports public K–12 schools and opposes diverting their funding to voucher programs.
schools.quote: Protect public K-12 education and oppose efforts to drain funds into unaccountable voucher programs.

safety.text: He supports police and first-responder training that includes de-escalation and mental-health crisis response.
safety.quote: Invest in advanced training for local police and first responders, including de-escalation, crisis intervention, mental health response, and emergency medical care.

immigration.text: He supports lawful pathways, due process, and alternatives to detention for families and asylum seekers.
immigration.quote: Fix a broken immigration system with lawful pathways and due process.

guns.text: He supports closing background-check loopholes and red-flag laws for people who pose an imminent danger.
guns.quote: Close loopholes that allow guns to be sold without background checks. Support red-flag laws to keep firearms away from those who pose an imminent danger.

health.text: He proposes a planned transition to universal healthcare and supports expanding access to affordable coverage.
health.quote: Implement planned step-by step transition to universal healthcare.

tax.text: He proposed eliminating the income tax after paying off the national debt.
tax.quote: Once these have reduced the debt to nothing, eliminating it, lets eliminate income tax, and pay for what's left of government without taxpayer expense.

wages.text: In a 2021 questionnaire, he disagreed that government should ensure everyone has a livable income.
wages.quote: It is the government’s responsibility to ensure everyone has a livable income. Disagree

trade.text: He said tariffs raise costs for importing-country consumers and should be used sparingly.
trade.quote: Tariffs are paid by the consumer in the importing country. Thus, those imposed by us are taxes paid by us on certain imported goods.

debt.text: He said paying down the national debt would help Americans retain more of their income and proposed a student loan fund tied to debt reduction.
debt.quote: We can allow students to borrow from the fund that accrues as we reduce the debt. Interest can be as low as 3% fixed, and anything they pay will reduce their debt as well as the national debt.

schools.text: He strongly disagreed with school choice and vouchers, arguing that recipient schools could raise tuition beyond what public school families can afford.
schools.quote: Vouchers are simply handouts for the wealthy. Recipient schools can simply raise their tuition and fees beyond what the public school family can afford.

immigration.text: He proposed allowing immigrants to enter and work freely after paying fees, passing background checks, and waiving federal benefits.
immigration.quote: We should allow the immigrant to pay for entry and pay to stay. All funds they pay should go specifically to reduce our debt. Let them live and work freely and invest in America. They should sign a waiver acknowledging they are not eligible for federal benefits.

guns.text: When asked what gun-ownership restrictions were needed for public safety, he answered that none were needed.
guns.quote: What restrictions on gun ownership are needed to protect public safety? NONE

abortion.text: He said elective abortion should be allowed when the mother chooses and answered that the federal government should not limit abortion.
abortion.quote: Under what circumstances should an elective abortion be allowed? When the moher chooses Does the federal government have a role to play in limiting abortion, and if so what federal steps and/or federal legislation would you support? No

health.text: He proposed consumer choice among membership, employer, and ACA coverage along with more competition, combining public and private options.
health.quote: Let the consumer choose between membership insurance, employer coverage, or ACA, let them choose their provider, and the level of service they need. Let's restore complete competition to healthcare., and watch the prices fall.
